methodology.zeroRule: For every form observed at least once in the source part, missing witness/form combinations are assigned count=0 because the NINJAL frequency pages list only non-zero witness counts.
methodology.allFormsRatio: count / sum(count) for the same witness and kana across all glyphs and diacritic classes.
methodology.sameDiacriticRatio: count / sum(count) for the same witness, kana, and diacritic class. If that class has total 0 in the witness, ratio is null.
methodology.warning: These are descriptive corpus shares, not probabilities of historically correct glyph choice and not universal usage rules.
